audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Lucian levels 2, 3, 6 and 2+ items and called the lane Favoured at 4/10, on a 36% win rate.
audit.why: The mirror slice already settled the chart as Lucian, Skill, Darius, Darius, Darius, Darius, Darius; restating it from Lucian's side keeps the directions agreeing, and the difficulty text has to follow.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-6 flipped as matched pairs with inverted ratings; difficulty raised to 7.5/10 and carry threat to 8/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was a Lucian row, and the late-game text claimed items let you kite him — which contradicts the settled chart.
audit.why: Noxian Guillotine is 120/100/80s, deals true damage that scales with Hemorrhage stacks and refreshes on a kill; Apprehend falls from 26s to 16s, so the pull window closes as the game goes on. No armour purchase answers true damage.
audit.corrected: Level 6 and 2+ items now belong to Darius, and late/whys[6]/spikes[3] stop promising a kite comeback.

audit.whatIsWrong: Apprehend's real cooldown never appeared, and Crippling Strike's auto reset was absent.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s at 535 range and also passively ignores a share of armour; Crippling Strike is a 5s auto reset that slows. Decimate heals him off champions hit by the blade, which is what makes Grievous Wounds matter.
audit.corrected: 26s added to the do's and key-interactions block, the reset tell added to the don'ts, and Executioner's tied to Decimate.

edits.before: E online — dash-weave trades start now: spell, double-shot, dash out before his answer lands.
edits.after: E online, but one Apprehend flips the trade — even, and decided by whether the pull lands.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-AA-E-AA-W-AA strings chunk a third of his HP. Trade on every CS he takes from the wrong angle.
edits.after: Hemorrhage stacks and Decimate's outer blade heals him — the moment he pulls you in, the trade is his.

edits.before: Keep the pressure rolling but track Apprehend (Pull) — your lead is HP-bar bullying, not all-in math, until items arrive.
edits.after: Five bleed stacks plus the Decimate heal make every extended trade his, and your E buys exactly one escape.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Noxian Guillotine (120s) is true damage that grows per bleed stack and refreshes on a kill.

edits.before: First item spike is your kill window — the dash-weave combo now deletes half bars. Force the issue before he stabilizes.
edits.after: His all-in is complete: Apprehend into an empowered Decimate into Guillotine kills you before Relentless Pursuit is back.

edits.before: You fall off relative to top-lane scalers — convert the lead into towers and roams before the 3-item brawlers arrive.
edits.after: Armour does nothing against Noxian Guillotine's true damage — never sidelane into him; group and use your range.

edits.before: The pull starts every Darius kill pattern — bait it before stepping up. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Apprehend is 26 seconds at rank 1 — bait the pull out, then take your whole string while it is down.

edits.before: That’s Darius’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Crippling Strike resets his auto — step back on the wind-up, not the cast.

edits.before: Track Darius’s Apprehend (Pull): The pull starts every Darius kill pattern — bait it before stepping up. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Apprehend (26s at rank 1): the pull starts every kill pattern, and Crippling Strike's reset is the wind-up tell.

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + pot. First: Kraken Slayer or Essence Reaver into Berserker's Greaves; then Navori / The Collector by lane state. Add anti-heal early into his sustain.
edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + pot. First: Kraken Slayer or Essence Reaver into Berserker's Greaves; then Navori / The Collector by lane state. Buy Executioner's before he stacks Decimate heals.

edits.before: With Lord Dominik's and a zeal item you can finally kite his E range, so the duel becomes skill-based rather than a free Darius kill.
edits.after: Even with Lord Dominik's one Apprehend still ends you — Guillotine's true damage ignores what you buy, so group instead of sidelaning.

edits.before: Once you have Lord Dominik's / a zeal item you can finally kite his E range — your only realistic comeback window if you survived lane.
edits.after: Even with Lord Dominik's, one Apprehend (down to 16s) ends you — Noxian Guillotine's true damage ignores every defensive item.

edits.before: You don't win this 1v1 late, but the math finally moves toward you. With Lord Dominik's and a zeal item your move speed and range let you actually kite his E cooldown instead of dying to it, and his single-target bleed means little to a grouped Lucian. Stop dueling him entirely — take side waves only when his E is down, and let your range and your team's pick threat punish him stepping up for an all-in.
edits.after: You don't win this 1v1 late. Lord Dominik's and a zeal item help you kite between his cooldowns, but Apprehend is down to 16 seconds and Noxian Guillotine is true damage no armour answers — one pull is still the entire fight. Stop dueling him: take side waves only while his E is down, and let your range and your team's pick threat punish him stepping up for the all-in.

notes: Chart restated from the mirror's settled version, with the late-game text corrected so it no longer promises a kite comeback the chart denies. Packet suspectName "His Noxian Guillotine" is a FALSE POSITIVE — correct Riot name. No Grievous Wounds advice written for Lucian's own passive (ally-heal clause misfire); the anti-heal advice that remains is aimed at Decimate, which genuinely heals him.
